speakers.name: Dewayne Hall
speakers.title: Red Feather Farms
speakers.bio: Dewayne Hall is a national speaker on all things homesteading, from wildcrafting to animal husbandry, with a lifetime of knowledge that began with his grandfather teaching him woods skills, wild edibles, medicinal plants, and how to live in harmony with the land ? later deepened by time on the Navajo Reservation and a Texas A&M education. He went on to manage a 52-section ranch in west Texas and teach Agriculture and Biology for several years before retiring and, in 2016, building Red Feather Farms with his wife on a once-abandoned property. There they raise TexMaster meat goats, pasture chickens, honey bees, and an Elderberry farm, running their own private-label meat and herbal business while practicing rainwater catchment, composting, and other sustainable conservation methods. True to his motto "Homesteading on a Budget," Dewayne shares his experience through Red Feather Farms on Facebook and Instagram.

speakers.name: Pat Cotten
speakers.title: Bending Tree Ranch
speakers.bio: Pat Cotten of Bending Tree Ranch in Damascus, AR has been raising meat goats since 1997, with herds focused primarily on TexMaster and TMG-quality Myotonics, alongside past experience with Boer, Spanish, and Kiko goats. She works closely with Onion Creek Ranch and has been an instructor for the OCR GoatCamp since its founding in 2001, and she co-owns the free monthly online newsletter MeatGoatMania, published since 2009. Beyond raising and showing goats ? including volunteering as co-show superintendent at local and state Market and Boer shows and co-hosting Myotonic shows in her home state ? Pat's true passion is teaching new and experienced breeders the ins and outs of goat husbandry.

speakers.name: Ashley & Stewart Clouse
speakers.title: Restoration Farms
speakers.topic: Herbal Medicine ? Plant Walk ? Sheep Shearing
speakers.bio: Stewart and Ashley Clouse grew up in rural Nebraska, later spent a decade in the city, then hit the road full-time as an RVing family for three years before settling in the foothills of the Ozarks in Oklahoma's Green Country region, where they founded Restoration Farms. They're passionate about sharing the abundance of the land they steward and everything they're learning along the way, welcoming visitors for farm tours, classes, and field trips to see their progress firsthand. With family at the heart of everything they do, Stewart and Ashley have made it their mission to keep the farm and all its offerings family-friendly.

speakers.name: LaRaine & Chris Cihak
speakers.title: Bluff Creek Acres
speakers.topic: Rain water catchment, canning, and homestead 101
speakers.bio: Chris and LaRaine Cihak live off-grid on 40 acres in SE Oklahoma, powered by a solar system and a rainwater collection system Chris designed and built to serve as their main water source, along with smaller systems for their animals and garden. Their homestead journey began back in 2000 in Nebraska, where they started gardening, foraging, and hunting on a large backyard plot ? even collecting rainwater in 5-gallon buckets for their houseplants. Today their homestead includes raised garden beds, a greenhouse, and flowers, along with dogs, cats, layer chickens, meat chickens, and rabbits, with sheep planned for the future. Above all, Chris and LaRaine love sharing knowledge, learning from others, and building community.

speakers.name: Ryan Hooper
speakers.title: The Farm2Table Show
speakers.bio: Ryan Hooper is co-founder of The Farm2Table Show and a special guest at this year's Oklahoma Homestead Rendezvous. A storyteller and speaker passionate about faith-based homesteading and self-sufficiency, he brings heart, humor, and real-world insight to conversations about growing, raising, and sourcing food locally. This year he's presenting "7 Steps to Self-Reliance," drawing on his own journey to help audiences live more intentionally and take ownership of their food systems. Rooted in faith, family, and community, Ryan inspires people toward a more resilient, purpose-driven lifestyle.
